title: Warning Signs
prompt: I know a crisis may be developing when I notice these signs in myself:
entries: Feeling increasingly hopeless or trapped
Withdrawing from people and activities I usually enjoy
Difficulty sleeping or sleeping much more than usual
Thinking more about death or that others would be better off without me

title: Internal Coping Strategies
prompt: Things I can do on my own to take my mind off difficult thoughts:
entries: Take a slow walk, even just around the block
Listen to a playlist that usually lifts my mood
Write down what I am feeling without judging it
Make a warm drink and sit somewhere comfortable for ten minutes

title: People and Settings That Provide Distraction
prompt: People I can reach out to and places I can go to take my mind off things:
entries: A trusted friend — add their name here (placeholder)
A family member I feel comfortable with — add their name here (placeholder)
A calm public space like a library or park near your home (placeholder)

title: People I Can Ask for Help
prompt: People I can contact who know I may be struggling and can offer support:
entries: Trusted person 1 — add a real name and how to reach them (placeholder)
Trusted person 2 — add a real name and how to reach them (placeholder)
Trusted person 3 — add a real name and how to reach them (placeholder)

title: Professionals and Crisis Services I Can Contact
prompt: Professional support I can reach when I need more than friends can offer:
entries: My therapist or counsellor — add their contact details here (placeholder)
My GP or family doctor — add their contact details here (placeholder)
A crisis line in your country — look up the number from a trusted source (placeholder, no number stored here)

title: Making My Environment Safer
prompt: Steps I can take to reduce access to means during a crisis:
entries: Ask someone I trust to hold onto medications for me
Remove or secure any items that feel unsafe when I am in distress
Stay with someone rather than being alone until the feeling passes
